meanings.ret6m: Modest decline over 6 months, underperforming the market.
meanings.ret1y: Weak 1-year performance, lagging the broader market.
meanings.fromHigh: Deep drawdown from peak, significantly below recent highs.
meanings.rsi14: Approaching oversold levels — selling pressure building.
meanings.aboveMAs: Below all moving averages — downtrend or consolidation.
meanings.macd: MACD negative but improving — downtrend may be slowing.
meanings.vol: High volatility, larger swings than the typical stock.
meanings.beta: Low beta — relatively insulated from broad market swings.
meanings.mdd1y: Large 1-year drawdown — significant decline from peak.
meanings.sharpe: Poor risk-adjusted return — losses or gains don't justify the volatility.
meanings.pe: Low P/E ratio — trading at a discount, may signal value or concerns.
meanings.peVsSector: Roughly in line with sector valuation norms.
meanings.revGrowth: Strong revenue growth, expanding the top line.
meanings.roe: Strong return on equity, generating solid returns for shareholders.
meanings.liquidity: Moderate liquidity — sufficient for most trades.
